name: tool_search
description: Discover enabled tools without exposing every full schema up front. Use this to search or browse live available tools, then pick exact tool names for the next step.

query.description: Semantic search query describing the capability or task you want to find. Leave empty to browse available tools.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tools to return. Defaults to 8 and is capped at 25.

tool_names.description: Optional exact tool names to inspect directly instead of doing semantic search.

include_schema.description: When true, include the parameter schema for the returned tools.
